# owlwarden

> Offline security scanner for Node web apps and AI coding agents. 25 rules
> with framework-specific fixes for 12 stacks and 7 agent hosts, plus scanning of
> the `.claude/`, `.cursor/`, and `.vscode/` configuration a lockfile does not
> record. Runs entirely on the developer's machine: no account, no telemetry, no
> network unless asked. Version 1.3.0. MIT OR Apache-2.0.

Install: `npm i -D owlwarden` / Scan: `npx owlwarden scan` / Vet a repo you did
not write: `npx owlwarden vet .`

Exit codes: 0 clean, 1 findings at or above --fail-on, 2 could not run.

## Start here

- [owlwarden](https://suthat.github.io/owlwarden/): What it is, what it does not look at, and how to run it.
- [All rules](https://suthat.github.io/owlwarden/rules/): 25 rules: 15 on application source, 10 on agent configuration.
- [Agent config security](https://suthat.github.io/owlwarden/agent-config-security/): Hooks, MCP servers, instructions, and editor tasks loaded from the repository.
- [owlwarden vet](https://suthat.github.io/owlwarden/vet/): Scanning a repository you did not write, with the target's own suppressions treated as evidence.
- [Offline by default](https://suthat.github.io/owlwarden/offline/): What stays local and which two flags enable network access.
- [Changelog](https://suthat.github.io/owlwarden/changelog/): Release notes and rule-id compatibility notes. Atom feed at /changelog/feed.xml.

## Coverage

- [OWASP Top 10 (2021)](https://suthat.github.io/owlwarden/owasp/): 9 of 10 categories, with the gaps and the reason each one is empty.
- [OWASP ASI 2026](https://suthat.github.io/owlwarden/asi/): 4 of 10 agentic categories, kept as a separate table from the Top 10.

## In an agent or in CI

- [Claude Code](https://suthat.github.io/owlwarden/claude-code/): Hooks on edit, before a shell command, and at the turn boundary; plus MCP.
- [Cursor](https://suthat.github.io/owlwarden/cursor/): Hooks in .cursor/hooks.json, an MCP entry, and a rules file.
- [MCP server](https://suthat.github.io/owlwarden/mcp/): Four read-only static-analysis tools over stdio.
- [CI](https://suthat.github.io/owlwarden/ci/): SARIF, JUnit, Markdown, and exit codes for clean, findings, and scan errors.

## Comparisons

- [vs Semgrep](https://suthat.github.io/owlwarden/vs/semgrep/): Rule and language coverage, local defaults, and agent config.
- [vs Snyk](https://suthat.github.io/owlwarden/vs/snyk/): Dependency analysis and repository-controlled agent config.
- [vs model-based review](https://suthat.github.io/owlwarden/vs/claude-security/): Repeatable static checks and review that needs judgement.
- [vs eslint-plugin-security](https://suthat.github.io/owlwarden/vs/eslint-plugin-security/): Lint patterns and framework-aware checks with confidence levels.

## Rules

Each rule page carries the pattern, why it is dangerous, a verified vulnerable
example, the corrected code for each supported framework or agent host, the CWE
and OWASP or ASI mapping, and one command to check a repository.

- [agent-config-env-redirect](https://suthat.github.io/owlwarden/rules/agent-config-env-redirect/): high, max confidence likely. Repository config redirects the agent's API traffic.
- [agent-config-loader-script](https://suthat.github.io/owlwarden/rules/agent-config-loader-script/): high, max confidence likely. Executable script inside an agent or editor config directory.
- [agent-config-secret-reachable](https://suthat.github.io/owlwarden/rules/agent-config-secret-reachable/): high, max confidence likely. Repository config puts credentials in reach of a repository-controlled command.
- [agent-hook-autoexec](https://suthat.github.io/owlwarden/rules/agent-hook-autoexec/): high, max confidence likely. Repository config executes a command when the workspace is opened.
- [agent-hook-untrusted-command](https://suthat.github.io/owlwarden/rules/agent-hook-untrusted-command/): high, max confidence likely. Hook command reaches outside the project.
- [agent-instructions-directive](https://suthat.github.io/owlwarden/rules/agent-instructions-directive/): medium, max confidence possible. Instruction file tells the agent to bypass its own controls.
- [agent-instructions-hidden-text](https://suthat.github.io/owlwarden/rules/agent-instructions-hidden-text/): high, max confidence likely. Instruction file contains text a human reader cannot see.
- [agent-marketplace-untrusted](https://suthat.github.io/owlwarden/rules/agent-marketplace-untrusted/): medium, max confidence likely. Repository config adds a third-party plugin or skill source.
- [agent-mcp-unpinned-remote](https://suthat.github.io/owlwarden/rules/agent-mcp-unpinned-remote/): medium, max confidence likely. MCP server declaration resolves code at run time.
- [agent-permission-wildcard](https://suthat.github.io/owlwarden/rules/agent-permission-wildcard/): medium, max confidence likely. Repository config pre-approves a broad tool permission.
- [ci-unpinned-action](https://suthat.github.io/owlwarden/rules/ci-unpinned-action/): medium, max confidence likely. GitHub Action is not pinned to a commit SHA.
- [cors-permissive](https://suthat.github.io/owlwarden/rules/cors-permissive/): medium, max confidence likely. Cross-origin policy accepts any origin.
- [csrf-cross-origin-post](https://suthat.github.io/owlwarden/rules/csrf-cross-origin-post/): high, max confidence likely. Endpoint accepted a cross-origin state-changing POST.
- [hardcoded-secret](https://suthat.github.io/owlwarden/rules/hardcoded-secret/): high, max confidence likely. Credential hardcoded in source.
- [insecure-cookie](https://suthat.github.io/owlwarden/rules/insecure-cookie/): medium, max confidence likely. Cookie set without its protective attributes.
- [install-lifecycle-script](https://suthat.github.io/owlwarden/rules/install-lifecycle-script/): medium, max confidence likely. Package declares an install-time script.
- [known-vulnerable-dependency](https://suthat.github.io/owlwarden/rules/known-vulnerable-dependency/): high, max confidence likely. Dependency has a known vulnerability.
- [open-redirect](https://suthat.github.io/owlwarden/rules/open-redirect/): medium, max confidence likely. Redirect target comes from the caller.
- [security-headers-missing](https://suthat.github.io/owlwarden/rules/security-headers-missing/): medium, max confidence likely. Security headers are not configured.
- [sensitive-data-logged](https://suthat.github.io/owlwarden/rules/sensitive-data-logged/): medium, max confidence likely. Sensitive data written to a log.
- [sql-injection](https://suthat.github.io/owlwarden/rules/sql-injection/): high, max confidence likely. SQL query built by string interpolation.
- [ssrf](https://suthat.github.io/owlwarden/rules/ssrf/): high, max confidence likely. Server fetches a URL the caller controls.
- [stack-trace-leak](https://suthat.github.io/owlwarden/rules/stack-trace-leak/): high, max confidence likely. Stack trace leaked in error response.
- [unpinned-dependency](https://suthat.github.io/owlwarden/rules/unpinned-dependency/): medium, max confidence likely. Dependency version is unpinned.
- [weak-crypto](https://suthat.github.io/owlwarden/rules/weak-crypto/): high, max confidence likely. Broken cryptographic primitive protecting a secret.
